distance_definition: Camera optical center along optical axis to first visible stomach-wall intersection

duplicate_policy.rule: Connected components of exact bytes/pixels, exact pose, near pose or near image; retain one technically valid in-range candidate.

split_policy: unassigned; preserve scout/geometry/duplicate ancestry; no random frame split or invented independent groups
version_policy: old and resampled lesions remain separate candidates, shared normal frames have one sample identity; recency does not approve quality
distance_acceptance: 411 technical candidates; final dataset acceptance pending visual/source coverage review and GPU first-hit replay
